resources.string: Thanks for supporting Kiwu: no ads
Thanks for supporting Kiwu: you won\'t see ads anymore.
Kiwu is free and shows a small banner in the Tasks and Notes lists. Every feature is the same with or without ads; the one-time payment only removes them.
You already have the latest version

Your data is stored only on this device: no accounts and no server of our own. The app uses the Internet to download previews of links you paste into a note, to show the ad banner (Google AdMob), which may use the phone\'s advertising ID depending on your consent, and to ask Google Play whether there is a new version.
A new version of Kiwu is available
It downloads while you keep using the app. When it\'s done, you\'ll just need to restart it.
Restart Kiwu to use the new version. Your data is kept.
